items.title: DeVonta Smith: Chance to return for Week 6
items.text:
Head coach Nick Sirianni expressed hope Monday that Smith (hamstring) would return for this Sunday's game against the Panthers, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Could return for Week 6
items.text:
Head coach Nick Sirianni said Monday that he's "hopeful" that both Barkley (hamstring) and DeVonta Smith (hamstring) will both be cleared to play against the Panthers on Sunday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Deebo Samuel: Expected to miss a couple of weeks
items.text:
Samuel is expected to miss at least a couple weeks due to a hamstring injury he sustained during the 49ers' 32-29 win over the Seahawks on Sunday, David Lombardi of the San Francisco Standard reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jaylen Warren: Leader of Pittsburgh's backfield
items.text:
Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that he views Warren as "our featured player right now," Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Roman Wilson: Won't play Week 6 vs. Tampa Bay
items.text:
Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Wilson (finger) will not play against the Buccaneers on Sunday, Nick Farabaugh of SteelersNow.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
